out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. HAND SINK NEXT TO THE ICE MACHINE WAS USED TO DUMP ICE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CFM EDUCATED THE FOOD EMPLOYEES.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. HUMMUS (52F), CHICKEN CURRY (45F), COOKED CHICKEN (44F), AND ARTICHOKE WITH LAMB (45F) WERE STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EHS PROMPTED THE CFM TO DISCARD THE FOOD ITEMS..

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: HUMMUS WAS OVERFILLED IN DEEP PLASTICS CONTAINERS WITH LIDS TIGHTLY CLOSED AND FAILED TO COOL DOWN TO 41F AFTER BEEING STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS EDUCATED THE CFM.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. CFM ORDERED 3 FOOD THERMOMETERS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF BEVERAGE-AIR 2-DOOR FLAT TOP COOLER AT 44F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE UNIT WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: CFM SHARED THAT SALMON IS COOKED TO ORDER. CFM WAS NOT ABLE TO PRESENT PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR SALMON.
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. PLEASE OBTAIN A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR SALMON FROM VENDOR(S) WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS..

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: COOKED CHICKEN (44F), ARTICHOKE (44F), COOKED LAMB (44F), AND YOGURT (44F) WERE STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: YOGURT (44F) PREPARED ON 8/11/2025 WAS STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER FOR 8 DAYS BY THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: GRILLED SALMON.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PLEASE FORWARD THE UPDATED MENU TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. CFM EDUCATED THE FOOD EMPLOYEE.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: SANITIZING STEP OF HIGH-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER WAS NOT VERIFIED. SURFACE TEMPERATURE OF PLATE SIMULATING DISHWASHER TESTER WAS 143F.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. 3-COMPARTMENT SINK WAS SET UP TO SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. TOMATO SAUCE (80F) WAS STORED IN TRUE 1-DOOR FLAT TOP COOLER FOR 2 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CHICKEN STEW (43F) AND COOKED EGGPLANT (46F) WERE STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: UTENSILS WERE STORED IN A CONTAINER OF STAGNANT WATER AT 83F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM SENT THE UTENSILS BACK TO WASH.
